item.name: APIs.io Engineering Platform Search email messages

request.name: APIs.io Engineering Platform Search email messages

description.content: This endpoint returns information for each email that matches the search parameter(s).

query.description:
The beginning of the search date range.
Defaults to `now - 30 days`.

The end of the search date range.
Defaults to `now`.

Space delimited query term(s).
The search is case-insensitive.

The content of the following email metadata fields are searched:
* alert_id
* CC
* From (envelope_from)
* From Name
* final_disposition
* md5 hash (of any attachment)
* sha1 hash (of any attachment)
* sha256 hash (of any attachment)
* name (of any attachment)
* Reason
* Received DateTime (yyyy-mm-ddThh:mm:ss)
* Sent DateTime (yyyy-mm-ddThh:mm:ss)
* ReplyTo
* To (envelope_to)
* To Name
* Message-ID
* smtp_helo_server_ip
* smtp_previous_hop_ip
* x_originating_ip
* Subject
Controls whether the message action log in included in the response.
Filter messages by the provided disposition.
Filter messages by actions applied to them
